card.name: Biomarker cutoffs for selecting cancer patients
card.fires_on: Punctuation or linking words right inside a biomarker-testing definition, such as the opening bracket after PD-L1 expression or the space after IHC. Seen in oncology 'select patients based on' indications.

modes.label: Bracket after expression
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after positive PD-L1 expression, just before the CPS cutoff.
modes.example: select patients based on presence of positive PD-L1 expression<< (>>CPS ≥1) in resect

modes.label: Inside IHC scores
modes.description: The space or 'or' within HER2 staining scores like IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH+.

modes.label: Staining intensity wording
modes.description: Words describing how strongly tumor cells stain, in a positivity definition.
modes.example: (defined as ≥75% of tumor cells<< demonstrating>> moderate to strong membranous CLDN
